subject: Staff trajectory readout: weekly wins, risks, asks (Aug 21)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staff trajectory readout: weekly wins, risks, asks (Aug 21)

Morning all — quick weekly snapshot ahead of the QBR prep this afternoon. TL;DR: momentum in latency/cost ops, one production incident risk pending, two asks (decision + headcount). See attached one-pager and metrics workbook.

Wins
- Serving runtime: 12% median token-cost reduction after the new batching heuristic landed (canaries green since Tue).
- Dedicated capacity: successful dry-run for Canary Batch A -> full rollout yesterday w/o throttling.
- Customer health: Acme POC moved to pilot after our 2-week perf window; Jim confirmed internal procurement cadence.

Risks / Flags
- Incident window: "KV cache evaporation" event on 8/18 caused ~3m of elevated latency for <1% of requests. Root cause points to a race during partial GC when concurrency spikes. Engineering hypothesis and mitigation plan below. This is our top risk for QBR.
- Renewals: One mid-market renewal (Olive Integrations) flagged a security question on data residency. CS is coordinating, but legal may need to approve a limited addendum.

Asks (clear, with owners and dates)
1) Decision: Approve expanded post-QBR SRE budget (+0.6 FTE equivalent) to accelerate the cache hardening work. Owner: laura_bennett — need a go/no-go by EOD Mon (8/23).
2) Headcount ask: greenlight hiring recruiter for 1 infra engineer (quantized-inference runtime). Owner: karthik_iyer — please confirm by Tue (8/24) if we should proceed.
3) Exec-facing slide: Review the attached one-pager and call out the incident mitigation timeline; I will update and freeze by Thu (8/26). Owner: marissa_cole (ops comms).

Notes on mitigation (short)
- Short term: rollback of the newest GC variant available as a hotfix (deployable in 30m), already staged.
- Medium term: add a concurrency gate and stronger KV persistence during GC (engineering lead: soojin_lee), ETA 3 weeks.

Attachments: 20270821-qbr-onepager.pdf (one-page summary); runway-metrics-aug21.xlsx (slices: latency, cost/token, capacity headroom).

Ask for replies: please respond with approvals inline (1), (2) and any phrasing changes for the QBR slide by Tue COB.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Forwarding note: will post the live QBR slide link to the drive once Marissa confirms final language.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Jordan — thanks for the concise readout. Quick notes:
- I tentatively approve the +0.6 SRE allocation for the cache hardening pilot. I'll confirm final budget with finance first thing Mon and send a short email here.
- For the QBR slide, can we add a single-line "customer impact" metric (requests affected and average latency delta) — makes the ask more concrete.

Also, please include a very short blameless timeline for the incident (timestamped). That will make the audit folks happy.

Laura
